## Changes and verification
Describe the user-visible outcome and list the commands actually run, their
results, and any platform checks not performed. Do not label mocked, emulated
or extraction-only tests as native installation acceptance.

## Release / security impact
State whether configuration, migrations, permissions, update compatibility,
third-party licensing, or production resources change. Include rollback and
rollout constraints. Never attach credentials, employee logs or private audit
reports. A PR merge does not authorize deployment or publication.
